xna-type.name: ContentImporterContext
xna-type.summary: Provides properties that define logging behavior for the importer.

constructor.summary: This constructor is available only when developing for Windows.

property.name: IntermediateDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The directory for storing temporary build files.

property.name: Logger
property.summary: Gets the logger for an importer.
property.value: Logger that contains information on warnings and debug messages generated during importation.

property.name: OutputDirectory
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.
property.value: The output directory for the final build results.

method.name: AddDependency
method.summary: Adds a dependency to the specified file. This causes a rebuild of the file, when modified, on subsequent incremental builds.

overload.summary: Adds a dependency to the specified file. This causes a rebuild of the file, when modified, on subsequent incremental builds.
overload.remarks: Do not call this method for the main file passed to the Import method. It is only required for additional files needing to be read by the importer.
